author: xMasterSlayer
body:
Hey Guys, 

Ik this account is old but that is because it is my older brothers last account. Anyway, he recommended I try this server and also try to join a team to get the full avicus experience, however, I am new and wondering if I could get all my stats and stuff reset as it isn't accurate to me and that makes it hard to join teams if they don't have an accurate understanding of my performance skills? I am looking forward to playing here and I'm keen to learn from the best!!!

Thanks, xMasterSlayer
